15-Year-Old Girl Asks Elon Musk 8 Questions Before Her Death; He Answers Them. A 15-year-old girl named Liv, who was battling cancer, had the opportunity to ask Elon Musk eight questions before her passing. After her death, her mother shared the handwritten list of questions with Glenn Beck, who then posted it online. Musk responded directly to the post, answering each question. This heartwarming story highlights the impact that people can have on one another, even in the face of adversity.
